name: Resend
shortDescription: Developer-first transactional email API with React/HTML templates and strong deliverability tooling.
description: Resend is our transactional email layer: authentication flows, notifications, and product email delivered through a clean API with proper domain authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and deliverability visibility. It replaces the old choice between wrestling SMTP yourself and adopting a heavyweight marketing suite you didn't want.
useCases: Authentication and account emails (magic links, verification, resets)
